packages.headline: 『GTA6』なんとメタスコア「99点」を獲得！！ オリジナル版『ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ』に並ぶ“歴代最高点”を現時点で記録

sources.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News
sources.evidenceText:
約13年ぶりの最新作が圧倒的スコアを叩き出し、もちろん今年のゲームランキングでもトップに躍り出る
『GTA6』なんとメタスコア「99点」を獲得！！ オリジナル版『ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ』に並ぶ“歴代最高点”を現時点で記録
ロックスター・ゲームスから11月19日に発売予定の 『グランド・セフト・オートVI』（以下、GTA6） が、海外レビュー集積サイト Metacritic にて、PS5版とXbox Series X版のいずれもメタスコア「99点」をマークした。
『GTA6』は、2013年発売の『グランド・セフト・オートV』から約13年ぶりとなるシリーズ最新作。バイスシティを含む架空の州「レオナイダ」を舞台にした、オープンワールド型のクライムアクションゲームだ。
11月18日時点のレビュー一覧には、PS5版が144件、Xbox Series X版が11件掲載されている。99点は 2026年のゲームランキング で最高点となっており、1998年に発売されたNINTENDO 64版『ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ』と並ぶ、同サイトの歴代最高スコアを記録した。
なお、メタスコアは本稿執筆時点のもので、今後のレビュー追加などにより変動する場合がある。
満点となる100点を付けたIGNは、精緻な作り込みや、さまざまな遊び方を試せる点を高く評価。レビュアー自身がこれまでプレイしたなかでもっとも感銘を受けたゲームと評している。

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Internet provider Xfinity has reported a massive spike in traffic on Xbox consoles for GTA 6's New Zealand launch.
GTA 6 Launch Causes Massive Spike in Traffic for Internet Provider Xfinity
Xfinity says it saw a jump in Xbox hardware traffic four times more than normal around the time GTA 6 became available in New Zealand. Although Xfinity provides its services in the United States, Xbox users were able to take advantage of a loophole that let them change their console's region to New Zealand, allowing them start playing the game early despite their actual geographic location. It's one of the only real notable advantages Xbox has had over PlayStation with this game, as Rockstar secured a marketing deal to advertise GTA 6 as playing best on PS5.
Right now, we still don't know how many copies of GTA 6 have sold, but we'll likely hear something by the end of this week or very early next week, depending on how quickly Rockstar wants to boast. This is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all-time, after all, and the official numbers will likely be eyewatering.
From a critical perspective, GTA 6 has received nothing but praise. IGN gave the game a 10 for its impeccable attention to detail and unprecedented depth, but we weren't alone in that analysis. The game is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest rated game on Metacritic. It's also nominated for Game of the Year , in addition to seven other awards at The Game Awards.
However, these hours of early access have proven to be very lucrative for Xbox players. As a result, tons of footage for the game has been circulating on social media all day long. Major content creators also took advantage of the New Zealand trick, resulting in record-breaking viewership across platforms like Twitch . As of this afternoon, Twitch reported that tens of millions of watch hours had already been accumulated.

packages.headline: GTA 6 Will Never Get a 60fps Update on PlayStation Pro as It's 'Not Powerful Enough'

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
There's bad news for any GTA 6 fans still hoping for a 60fps option on PlayStation 5 Pro.
GTA 6 Will Never Get a 60fps Update on PlayStation Pro as It's 'Not Powerful Enough'
While Sony's beefier PS5 is arguably the most powerful console on the market today, even it is unable to run Rockstar's new masterpiece at 60fps. That's according to the game's technology production director Marc Chambers, who admitted that the PS5 Pro could only do so much.
Somewhat controversially, GTA 6 targets 30fps across all of its supported console platforms, with the same rate on everything from the under-powered Xbox Series S all the way up to PS5 Pro.
Naturally, there are other differences — and the game's PS5 Pro version has a few extra bells and whistles. But anyone expecting a better frame rate will need to temper their expectations — at least, perhaps, until the game's PC version arrives.
Speaking to IGN, Rockstar's co-studio head and head of development Rob Nelson said that "too much" of GTA 6 would have to fundamentally change for the game to target 60fps. "Too much, too much," he said in our big GTA 6 interview that went live today . "It wouldn’t have been acceptable to anybody. The simple answer is, when you ask the technical team, they're, like, 'Have you seen it?' There’s too many compromises that would've had to have been made to do that, is the short answer."
Today also brings more detail on how GTA 6 fares while running on Xbox Series S , where it is one of the first games to use AMD's FSR 4.1 on Xbox to upscale the graphically demanding game from 720p to 1080p.
IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.

packages.headline: Rockstar President Sam Houser Issues Rare Statement to Celebrate GTA 6 Launch

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
As GTA 6 launches around the world, Rockstar president and co-founder Sam Houser has issued a rare statement to celebrate the occasion and "many more years" of experiences ahead.
Rockstar President Sam Houser Issues Rare Statement to Celebrate GTA 6 Launch
While other high-ranking Rockstar staff have discussed GTA 6 in interviews thus far, the famously reclusive producer has now outlined his company's intentions with the game, and suggested there was much more to come in future.
"Rockstar Games was founded on the belief that games could achieve the same distinction as all other forms of storytelling, become essential to modern culture, and to be thought of as stories and worlds that live on with all of us," Houser began, in a statement shared with IGN's GTA 6 reviewer, Luke Reilly .
"We hope it felt both familiar and entirely new, and above all, we hope that you had fun. We are incredibly grateful to you and everything that you do to celebrate games. We look forward to many more years of sharing these experiences with you.
While Houser's rare statement is notable enough on its own, the mention of "many more years" of experiences from Rockstar will inevitably excite fans already wondering what's next from the company. While the base GTA 6 offers hundreds of hours of experiences to discover and enjoy, there is of course huge speculation surrounding the game's unannounced but inevitable online portion. As of yet, Rockstar has not discussed its next iteration of GTA Online at all, though fans expect to hear something of it sooner or later.
"We have tried to create an experience that will exceed your expectations."

『Videogame Automation Engineer』は、いろいろなミニゲームを自動で攻略する仕組みを作る自動化プログラミングゲームである。プレイヤーはゲームのテスターとして、クライアントから届くゲームのテストを請け負うことになる。ゲームの内容はさまざまで、すべてを手動でプレイしていては埒が明かない。そこで、ゲーム内の様子を検知するセンサーや、ANDやNOTといった各種論理回路、そしてゲームのコントローラーを組み合わせて、ゲームを自動で攻略するのだ。

packages.headline: PlayStation emerges victorious in a $2.6 billion lawsuit alleging a digital monopoly

sources.label: Game Developer
sources.evidenceText:
The now-dismissed lawsuit accused PlayStation of setting "excessive and unfair prices" in the UK, but will not proceed any further.
PlayStation emerges victorious in a $2.6 billion lawsuit alleging a digital monopoly
A $2.6 billion class action lawsuit brought in the United Kingdom against PlayStation has been dismissed by London's Competition Appeal Tribunal, clearing PlayStation of unfair practices that were alleged when the lawsuit was filed in 2023, noted by VGC .
The lawsuit, brought by UK consumer rights activist Alex Neil and representing the UK's 8.9 million PlayStation customers, argued that Sony's 30 percent cut on all digital purchases made on the PlayStation store while also determining prices on said store constitute an abuse of its dominant position and lead to excessive prices.
The appeal tribunal did not agree with Neill's arguments, though perhaps not for enduring reasons. Part of the tribunal's reasoning is that PlayStation cannot maintain a monopoly over digital sales when physical sales are a consumer option, production of which PlayStation will be abandoning in 2028 . But overall, the court was not swayed by the argument that PlayStation games were priced too high on the platform's digital store, so it is unlikely the removal of physical games as an option will change the tribunal's minds.
On the website for the class action , Neill and her lawyers argue that the current dynamic is rife for abuse and Sony is overcharging relative to the costs of these products.

packages.headline: “サイバーパンク特濃”アクションRPG『アセント』に約4年ぶりのアプデ到来、開発元が本気の磨き直し。やっと言える「今こそ遊びどき」

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
アクションシューティングRPG『アセント（The Ascent）』の、約4年ぶりとなるアップデート「Legacy Patch」では、遊びやすさが大幅改善されている。
“サイバーパンク特濃”アクションRPG『アセント』に約4年ぶりのアプデ到来、開発元が本気の磨き直し。やっと言える「今こそ遊びどき」
Neon Giantは11月19日、アクションシューティングRPG『 アセント（ The Ascent） 』の、約4年ぶりとなるアップデート「Legacy Patch」を配信する。今回は『アセント』がどのようなゲームなのか振り返りながら、最新パッチを適用した本作がどのように変化したのかプレイフィールを交えてお伝えしたい。
『アセント』は、スウェーデンのデベロッパーNeon Giantが開発した、サイバーパンクの世界観をもつアクションシューティングRPG。対応プラットフォームはPC（ Steam / Microsoft Store ）/ PS5 / P S 4 / XBOX Series X|S / XBOX One で、 Nintendo Switch 2 版が12月3日に発売予定だ。舞台となるのは、犯罪の蔓延るスラム街から、支配層の住む居住区までさまざまな区域が存在するメトロポリスだ。すべての人間を管理していた超巨大企業アセント・グループが突如活動を停止したことで、街の秩序は崩壊。プレイヤーは、この事変の原因を探ることとなる。
そうしたなか、『アセント』発売から6年目を迎えようとする今年7月に、Neon Giantは突如として本作のアップデートを発表した。最後のパッチ配信から、実に約4年ぶりのアップデートとなる。その理由として、開発チームは本作の成果に誇りを持っていると語る一方、多くのプレイヤーが遭遇したであろうバグにも言及。そうした問題について言い訳をするつもりはないと謝罪し、近日公開予定のパッチによって、多数の不具合を修正すると発表したのだ。
なお、本作はNintendo Switch 2向けに『 The Ascent「アセント」 アルティメットエディション 』として12月3日に発売される予定だ。同エディションには、既存の3種類のDLCパックがすべて収録されるほか、「Legacy Patch」の修正や改善も適用されるという。
そうした表現をさらにパワーアップしてくれるのが、「Legacy Patch」であらたに対応した「HDR：High Dynamic Range」機能だ。HDRの利用には対応モニターが必要になるものの、従来のSDRの映像と比べて、より広いダイナミックレンジを表現できるようになる。もともと美麗なビジュアルで評価されていた『アセント』。HDRの実装によってその世界をさらに深く味わえるようになるのではと、期待を膨らませながら有効化してみたところ、その効果は想像以上だった。
そんな作り込まれた背景グラフィックに説得力を与えているのが、同様に緻密に構築された世界設定の数々だろう。本作の舞台は、銀河中からさまざまな種族がやってくる惑星ヴェレスの超高層過密都市（アーコロジー）。そこでは政府の代わりに超巨大企業アセント・グループが支配しており、莫大な借金を背負ってヴェレスへとやってきた人々に過酷な労働生活を強いている。さらに、そうした社会の裏側では、シンジケートやギャングが暗躍し、さまざまな異星人たちがそれぞれの思惑から勢力闘いを繰り広げている。
まずは、今回のアップデートに至るまでの経緯を振り返っておきたい。本作は2021年にPC（Steam/Microsoft Store）およびXBOX Series X|S/XBOX One向けに、2022年にはPS5/PS4向けに発売された、ツインスティック型のシューティングゲームだ。サイバーパンクという世界観から、前年に発売された『サイバーパンク2077』などとも比較されながらも、細部まで作り込まれたビジュアルや、爽快感のあるアクションなどが高い評価を集めていた。

packages.headline: 『アークナイツ』の『モンスターハンター』コラボ、原作再現が細かすぎると話題に。『ライズ』ミノトの“ゆるい絵”から、古参ハンターに刺さる「かつかつボックス」いじりまで

sources.evidenceText:
『アークナイツ』の『モンスターハンター』コラボについて、プレイヤーの間で再現度の高さが話題となっている。

Yostarは11月16日、Hypergryphが開発する 『アークナイツ』 にて、『モンスターハンター』シリーズとのコラボイベント「泡影を穿つ碧雷」を開始した。プレイヤーの間で再現度の高さが話題となっている。
『アークナイツ』は運営型タワーディフェンスゲームだ。プレイヤーは製薬会社「ロドス・アイランド」、通称ロドスにおける指揮官「ドクター」として、仲間と共に大陸テラに蔓延る不治の伝染病「源石病（オリパシー）」と、その感染者にまつわる諸問題を解決するため立ち向かう。ロドスは製薬会社でありながら、問題解決のためならば政治的な駆け引きをし、武力を行使する力をも持つ組織である。特定の勢力に属さない中立姿勢を保ちながら、ただ源石病の打倒、そして感染者の救済のために邁進するのだ。
さらに、マップの形状として『モンスターハンターライズ』に登場した「百竜夜行」をモチーフとしたものもあり、モンスター図鑑に記録されるモンスターたちのイラストもひとつひとつ描かれている。コラボを機に『アークナイツ』に触れるハンターにとって、新たな獲物に出会った気持ちになれるかもしれない。
ちなみに、いつもであればドローンからの空撮として表現されているマップ確認画面では、「EYESOFPRIESTESS」といった文字列が確認できる。コラボイベントでありながらも、しっかりと『アークナイツ』の世界観も反映されているのだ。今回のコラボイベントでは『アークナイツ』と『モンスターハンター』シリーズ、双方の要素をふんだんに取り入れつつ、両者がうまく溶け込んだ世界を楽しめるだろう。
『 アークナイツ 』はPC/iOS/Android向けに配信中。コラボイベント「泡影を穿つ碧雷」を開催中だ。
本作は過去にも『モンスターハンター』シリーズとのコラボイベント「紅炎遣らう落葉」を開催していたが、今回のイベント「泡影を穿つ碧雷」ではより一層の細かな再現がされているとして話題になっている。ストーリー上の描写や台詞、アイテムのフレーバーテキスト、モンスター図鑑やプロフィール用装飾などのイラスト、クエスト説明文やマップの形状など、『モンスターハンター』シリーズのファンが思わずニヤリと微笑んでしまう要素が散りばめられているのだ。

packages.headline: A GTA 6 Location Was Teased by Rockstar All the Way Back in 2021 — And What's Inside Was Worth the Wait

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
In 2021, Rockstar fans believed that a GTA 6 screenshot was snuck into the GTA trilogy collection, but there's more to this theory than meets the eye.
A GTA 6 Location Was Teased by Rockstar All the Way Back in 2021 — And What's Inside Was Worth the Wait
SPOILER WARNING: This article features details on a GTA 6 Easter egg. Although it won't ruin the game's story or anything like that, we recognize some people want to organically discover and find interesting things on their own. You've been warned!
In 2021, Rockstar Games released the somewhat controversial remastered collection of the PS2 era GTA titles. It was... a mess, to say the least. However, one notable thing came from that collection, but fans weren't sure if it actually meant anything. There was a picture of a house in this new version of GTA: San Andreas that wasn't there in the original game, and it didn't look like a location from any other GTA game. Fans theorized this was actually our first look at GTA 6 ... and it turns out, they were right!
The house is real. It's located in Leonard County, in the suburb of Belville (shoutout Jared from the GTA mapping community for discovering this). However, that's just the tip of the iceberg. If you approach the house's garage, you can actually break in. Upon entry, it becomes clear this is a lair for some kind of conspiracy theorist. These aren't just ordinary in-universe ramblings — they're from someone who believes they are in a video game.
All credit goes to Jared from the GTA VI Mapping server. The house is located in Belville. (https://t.co/hWt1Koz3uz) https://t.co/t2ZsSRPQFI
It's a very silly Easter egg, and one that leans into the absurdity of the GTA community in many ways. It's unclear whether this house was always meant to be like this, or if someone at the studio decided to have some fun with it after they saw how mad it drove fans. Either way, it gave me a good chuckle.
In related news, GTA 6 is already shattering all kinds of records despite not being out globally. The game is driving tons of traffic to Twitch, YouTube, and Kick, with millions of people just watching the game. As for its critical reception, GTA 6 got a 10/10 from IGN and its critical praise has been echoed across the industry. In addition to being nominated for Game of the Year , GTA 6 is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest rated game of all-time on Metacritic . While its position could change as more reviews trickle in over the next few weeks, it's clear this game is a gargantuan hit (though that likely isn't surprising).

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's Lead Writer Has Left Sandfall to Help Game Devs Tell Better Stories
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ’s lead writer has left Sandfall to help other game developers think about story from the outset. Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, the narrative lead for Expedition 33, won a BAFTA Breakthrough U.S. award earlier this year, and she’s since been consulting on stories across the industry.
Expedition 33 was her first video game (she came from a career in private equity), but it won more than 400 awards and received almost universal critical acclaim, in part due to its blend of real-time and traditional turn-based RPG mechanics, and partly because of its mysterious story, strong emotional beats, and brilliant characters.
Svedberg-Yen is now setting up a fund with the aim of advancing narrative design in video games and nurturing new writing talent.
“I feel that we are losing so much institutional knowledge,” Svedberg-Yen told GamesBeat . “We’re making it extraordinarily difficult for a younger generation of developers to have formative experiences. There’s so much disruption in the industry right now.”
